將兩個世界的選區投影到相同的公尺座標，對齊窗格寬度與格網。比較 200 m 時，: Project the selections from both worlds into the same metric coordinates, aligning window width and grid. When comparing at 200 m, check whether the native DEMs on both sides are actually fine enough.
小尺度候選做八種旋轉與鏡像疊合。可選原本各窗格獨立正規化的形狀差，或補入起伏相近: Small-scale candidates are overlaid under eight rotations and reflections. You can choose the original shape gap with each window normalized independently, or add candidates with similar relief and then fine-rank by real metric RMSE after median-height alignment; both sides use the same metric grid spacing. Earth windows also show the intersection fractions of state geologic map units, 2024 30 m land-cover fractions and NASA POWER regional climate. Climate does not take part in ranking. The geologic map and land cover can be used to optionally exclude windows with a double conflict, but they do not change the geometric score; measured lithology and cross-body expert ground truth are still missing.
